doc: One complete corpus publication: every finding, the patterns that argue for them, and what the corpus does instead.

envelope.doc: Counts and absolute offsets for every section behind it.

fields.name: magic
fields.doc: `SOUS`, little-endian.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: FORMAT_VERSION. A reader that does not know it stops.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0: every span is raw-book UTF-16 rather than bytes.

fields.name: bookCount
fields.doc: Directory rows, in caller order.

fields.name: recordLen
fields.doc: The record stride, 16.

fields.name: totalFindings
fields.doc: Records across every book's section.

fields.name: patternCount
fields.doc: Rows in the pattern table.

fields.name: patternOffset
fields.doc: Where the pattern table starts, absolute.

fields.name: snapshotId
fields.doc: Opaque identity of the snapshot; a finding handle is this plus a row.

fields.name: clusterCount
fields.doc: Entries in the cluster section.

fields.name: clusterOffset
fields.doc: Where it starts: the running cursor after the pattern table.

fields.name: terminalCount
fields.doc: Entries in the terminal section.

fields.name: terminalOffset
fields.doc: Where it starts: the running cursor after the cluster section.

envelope.doc: One row per book, in caller order.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The book code, ASCII.

fields.name: terminator
fields.doc: NUL.

fields.name: publishedLength
fields.doc: The book's length in the header's coordinate space; no span passes it.

fields.name: sectionOffset
fields.doc: Where this book's records start, absolute.

fields.name: findingCount
fields.doc: How many.

fields.name: idOffset
fields.doc: Where the caller's id for this book starts in the id strings.

envelope.bytes: per book: a u16 length, then that many UTF-8 bytes; padded to 4
envelope.doc: The caller's id for each book, in directory order.
The judge's output, one row per firing pattern; a Convention record names one by index.

fields.name: glyph
fields.doc: The scalar; u32::MAX is the pooled digit key.

fields.name: neighbor
fields.doc: The neighbouring scalar on ExactNeighbor; 0 on every other channel.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: The Channel discriminant, finest grain first.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: A byte each channel gives its own meaning.

fields.name: band
fields.doc: Staircase step; 0xFF is none.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0 LOOKALIKE, on a Rarity row only.

fields.name: numerator
fields.doc: How often the pattern occurred.

fields.name: denominator
fields.doc: Out of how many chances.

fields.name: shareBp
fields.doc: That share in basis points, at most 10,000.

fields.name: books
fields.doc: Books holding part of the numerator; books-possible is the header's bookCount.

fields.name: facing
fields.doc: ExactNeighbor only: the pair's Facing byte, 0 when it holds no directionless quote.

fields.name: usual
fields.doc: What is usual instead; each channel owns the meaning.

fields.name: usualCount
fields.doc: How often the usual occurred.

fields.name: otherCount
fields.doc: The third lane, per channel.

envelope.doc: The exact runs each RunShape row lists, each entry followed by atomCount u32 scalars.

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: The RunShape row this run is of.

fields.name: atomCount
fields.doc: Atoms stored after the entry, 1..=16, a u32 scalar each.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0 RECURRING, bit 1 TRUNCATED, the high nibble the run's Facing.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Corpus occurrences of exactly this run.

envelope.doc: What the corpus hands off to after each mark, one entry per mark and context.

fields.name: glyph
fields.doc: The mark, a scalar.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: Bit 0 QUOTED, bit 1 BRACKETED: what stood between mark and word.

fields.name: pad
fields.doc: Zero.

fields.name: upper
fields.doc: Handoffs to an uppercase letter.

fields.name: cased
fields.doc: Handoffs to a cased letter; never 0, at least upper.

envelope.doc: Fixed-width findings, one section per book, no padding.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: Start, in the coordinate space the header declares.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: End, exclusive.

fields.name: bookIndex
fields.doc: Into the directory; always this section's own book.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The rule code: the union tag the two lanes are read by.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Only SATURATED: a lane was clamped.

fields.name: laneA
fields.doc: An i16 whose meaning the rule code owns.

fields.name: laneB
fields.doc: A second i16 the rule code owns.
